Layla.name: Malefic Gun
Layla.description: Her shots hit harder the farther the target is from her.

Layla.name: Malefic Bomb
Layla.description: Fires an energy shot that damages the first enemy hit and extends her next attack's reach.

Layla.name: Void Projectile
Layla.description: Lobs a blast that slows the target and splashes damage onto enemies nearby.

Layla.name: Destruction Rush
Layla.description: Unleashes a long-range beam that pierces everything in a straight line.

Miya.name: Moon Blessing
Miya.description: Each attack on a target stacks attack speed; at full stacks her arrows split to hit extra targets.

Miya.name: Moon Arrow
Miya.description: Her next attacks fire additional arrows that also strike nearby enemies.

Miya.name: Arrow of Eclipse
Miya.description: Rains arrows on an area, damaging and slowing enemies inside, then slowing them further on repeat hits.

Miya.name: Hidden Moonlight
Miya.description: Clears debuffs, turns invisible briefly and gains a burst of movement and attack speed.

Tigreal.name: Fearless
Tigreal.description: Taking hits builds stacks that reduce the damage of the next enemy skill.

Tigreal.name: Attack Wave
Tigreal.description: Slams the ground in a line, damaging and slowing enemies in front of him.

Tigreal.name: Sacred Hammer
Tigreal.description: Charges forward and then swings his hammer to knock enemies up and toss them behind him.

Tigreal.name: Implosion
Tigreal.description: Drags nearby enemies toward himself and stuns them.

Eudora.name: Superconductor
Eudora.description: Her skills leave a mark that makes her next skill on that target deal extra damage.

Eudora.name: Forked Lightning
Eudora.description: Fires a fan of lightning that damages every enemy in the cone.

Eudora.name: Ball Lightning
Eudora.description: Hurls a lightning orb at one enemy, damaging them and cutting their defense.

Eudora.name: Thunder's Wrath
Eudora.description: Calls a lightning blast on an area, hitting hardest at the center and bursting on marked targets.

Zilong.name: Dragon Flurry
Zilong.description: After three hits his next basic attack strikes three times and heals him.

Zilong.name: Spear Flip
Zilong.description: Grabs an enemy and flips them over his shoulder, tossing them behind him.

Zilong.name: Spear Strike
Zilong.description: Dashes at a target with a rapid series of spear thrusts.

Zilong.name: Supreme Warrior
Zilong.description: Boosts movement and attack speed and becomes immune to slows for a while.

Balmond.name: Bloodthirst
Balmond.description: Killing a minion or hero restores a chunk of his HP.

Balmond.name: Soul Lock
Balmond.description: Charges forward and stops at the first enemy hero hit, slowing them.

Balmond.name: Cyclone Sweep
Balmond.description: Spins his axe to repeatedly damage everything around him.

Balmond.name: Lethal Counter
Balmond.description: Smashes the ground with a blow that deals more damage the less HP the target has.

Nana.name: Molina's Gift
Nana.description: When hit hard she briefly becomes untargetable and drops a Molina that slows enemies.

Nana.name: Magic Boomerang
Nana.description: Throws a boomerang that damages enemies on the way out and back.

Nana.name: Molina Smooch
Nana.description: Sends a Molina that turns the enemy hit into a harmless creature for a moment.

Nana.name: Molina Blitz
Nana.description: Summons three Molina attacks in an area that damage and slow enemies.

Estes.name: Scripture of the Moon Elf
Estes.description: Every few attacks his basic attack heals himself and slows the target.

Estes.name: Moonlight Immersion
Estes.description: Links to an ally and heals them over time while they stay close.

Estes.name: Domain of Moon Goddess
Estes.description: Creates a field that damages and slows enemies passing through it.

Estes.name: Blessing of Moon Goddess
Estes.description: Heals all nearby allies and empowers his healing links for a while.

Alucard.name: Pursuit
Alucard.description: After using a skill his next basic attack leaps to the target and strikes harder.

Alucard.name: Groundsplitter
Alucard.description: Jumps to a spot and slams down, damaging everything around him.

Alucard.name: Whirling Smash
Alucard.description: Spins his blade to hit surrounding enemies, healing based on damage dealt.

Alucard.name: Fission Wave
Alucard.description: Sends a slashing wave forward and gains extra lifesteal for a short time.

Franco.name: Wasteland Force
Franco.description: Regains HP and moves faster while he stays out of combat.

Franco.name: Iron Hook
Franco.description: Throws a hook that drags the first enemy hit back to him.

Franco.name: Fury Shock
Franco.description: Slams the ground to damage and slow enemies around him.

Franco.name: Bloody Hunt
Franco.description: Locks a target in place with a chain of rapid strikes.

Saber.name: Enemy's Bane
Saber.description: His attacks reduce the target's physical defense with stacking hits.

Saber.name: Orbiting Swords
Saber.description: Summons blades that circle him, then sends them flying at nearby enemies.

Saber.name: Charge
Saber.description: Dashes forward and damages enemies along the path.

Saber.name: Triple Sweep
Saber.description: Knocks a hero into the air and follows with a chain of slashes.

Karina.name: Shadow Combo
Karina.description: Every third hit on the same target deals bonus true damage.

Karina.name: Dance of Blades
Karina.description: Blocks incoming basic attacks and empowers her next strike to slow and crit.

Karina.name: Dance of Death
Karina.description: Spins her twin blades to damage everything around her.

Karina.name: Shadow Assault
Karina.description: Dashes to a target for heavy damage; a kill soon after resets the cooldown.

Angela.name: Smart Heart
Angela.description: Casting skills gives her a temporary burst of movement speed.

Angela.name: Love Waves
Angela.description: Fires heart projectiles that heal allies and damage enemies they pass through.

Angela.name: Puppet-on-a-String
Angela.description: Tethers an enemy, slowing them and dealing damage while the link holds.

Angela.name: Heartguard
Angela.description: Shields an ally and possesses them, letting her cast her skills from inside them.

Lesley.name: Lethal Shot
Lesley.description: Standing still charges her next shot with extra range and damage.

Lesley.name: Master of Camouflage
Lesley.description: Turns invisible and gains movement speed and crit rate.

Lesley.name: Tactical Grenade
Lesley.description: Throws a grenade that knocks back enemies and hops her backward.

Lesley.name: Ultimate Snipe
Lesley.description: Fires a series of long-range shots that lock onto one target.

Fanny.name: Air Superiority
Fanny.description: Damage dealt while flying builds energy and applies a mark for bonus damage.

Fanny.name: Tornado Strike
Fanny.description: Spins her blades to damage enemies close to her.

Fanny.name: Steel Cable
Fanny.description: Fires a cable and pulls herself to where it lands, slicing enemies on the way.

Fanny.name: Cut Throat
Fanny.description: Dives onto a target for burst damage that scales with her marks.

Gusion.name: Dagger Specialist
Gusion.description: Hitting an enemy with a skill marks them; his next basic attack detonates it.

Gusion.name: Sword Spike
Gusion.description: Throws a dagger, then can blink to the marked target.

Gusion.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
Gusion.description: Throws a fan of daggers and recalls them for a second wave of damage.

Gusion.name: Incandescence
Gusion.description: Dashes in a direction and resets his other skills.

Lancelot.name: Soul Cutter
Lancelot.description: Marked targets take extra damage when he lands his skills.

Lancelot.name: Puncture
Lancelot.description: Dashes through a target; hitting a new target lets him dash again.

Lancelot.name: Thorned Rose
Lancelot.description: Unleashes a flurry of stabs in a cone in front of him.

Lancelot.name: Phantom Execution
Lancelot.description: Becomes untargetable and charges forward with a devastating slash.

Chou.name: Only Fast
Chou.description: Every few steps his next basic attack pierces armor and slows.

Chou.name: Jeet Kune Do
Chou.description: A three-hit combo; the last hit knocks the target into the air.

Chou.name: Shunpo
Chou.description: Dashes forward, shrugging off crowd control with a shield.

Chou.name: The Way of Dragon
Chou.description: Kicks an enemy away and can follow up to kick them again.

Kagura.name: Yin Yang Gathering
Kagura.description: Retrieving her umbrella grants a shield and briefly disables nearby enemies.

Kagura.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
Kagura.description: Sends her umbrella to a spot, damaging and slowing enemies there.

Kagura.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
Kagura.description: Blinks a short distance, cleansing debuffs, with a different effect while holding the umbrella.

Kagura.name: Yin Yang Overturn
Kagura.description: Slams the umbrella to knock enemies back or pull them in, depending on where it sits.

Hayabusa.name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
Hayabusa.description: Each hit on the same hero stacks up bonus damage.

Hayabusa.name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
Hayabusa.description: Throws shuriken that slow enemies and steal a little energy.

Hayabusa.name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
Hayabusa.description: Casts four shadows he can teleport to for repositioning.

Hayabusa.name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
Hayabusa.description: Becomes untargetable and strikes a target repeatedly from the shadows.

Aamon.name: Invisible Armor
Aamon.description: Hitting an enemy lets him vanish and gain speed while regaining HP.

Aamon.name: Soul Shards
Aamon.description: Skills and hits charge his armor; when full, his next attack throws shards that scatter and keep striking.

Aamon.name: Slayer Shards
Aamon.description: Sends shards that scatter and return to him, damaging enemies on both paths.

Aamon.name: Endless Shards
Aamon.description: Rains shards on a target for damage that grows with their missing HP.

Akai.name: Tai Chi
Akai.description: Every skill cast grants a shield based on his max HP.

Akai.name: Headbutt
Akai.description: Charges forward and knocks the first enemy hero hit into the air.

Akai.name: Body Slam
Akai.description: Belly-flops onto the ground to damage and slow enemies nearby.

Akai.name: Heavy Spin
Akai.description: Spins for several seconds, pushing enemies around and shrugging off slows.

Aldous.name: Contract: Transform
Aldous.description: Casting a skill grants him a shield.

Aldous.name: Contract: Soul Steal
Aldous.description: His next attack hits harder and stores permanent stacks when it kills.

Aldous.name: Contract: Explosion
Aldous.description: Raises a guard that stuns nearby enemies when it ends.

Aldous.name: Contract: Chase Fate
Aldous.description: Reveals every enemy hero, then lets him dash to one for a heavy knockback strike.

Alice.name: Crimson Blood Banquet
Alice.description: Skill hits stack Crimson; at two stacks she drains nearby enemies while healing and moving faster.

Alice.name: Crimson Gleam
Alice.description: Fires blood energy forward and can recast to blink to where it is.

Alice.name: Doom Waltz
Alice.description: A dance that damages and heavily slows nearby enemies, scorching them while her banquet is active.

Alice.name: Throne of Ruin
Alice.description: Wraps herself in blood with control immunity, then slams down to damage and immobilize enemies around her.

Alpha.name: Beta, Advance!
Alpha.description: His skills mark enemies for Beta to strafe with extra damage.

Alpha.name: Rotary Impact
Alpha.description: Swings his blade in a wave and Beta follows up on the marked line.

Alpha.name: Force Swing
Alpha.description: Sweeps in a cone, slowing enemies and healing himself per hit.

Alpha.name: Spear of Alpha
Alpha.description: Fires a spear and pulls himself to it, knocking enemies up on arrival.

Argus.name: Warmonger
Argus.description: Attacks charge his blade; when full it deals bonus true damage.

Argus.name: Demonic Grip
Argus.description: Throws a chain to pull himself toward a target and slows nearby enemies.

Argus.name: Meteoric Sword
Argus.description: Slashes to leave a trail that boosts his movement and attack speed.

Argus.name: Eternal Evil
Argus.description: Becomes immune to death for a few seconds, converting damage into healing.

Arlott.name: Demon Gaze
Arlott.description: Enemies affected by crowd control get marked; his next hit on them heals him.

Arlott.name: Dauntless Strike
Arlott.description: Thrusts forward to damage and knock back enemies in a cone.

Arlott.name: Vengeance
Arlott.description: Dashes to a marked target and knocks them up.

Arlott.name: Final Slash
Arlott.description: Cuts a line that flings every enemy in it toward one side.

Atlas.name: Frigid Breath
Atlas.description: Emits a cold aura that slows nearby enemies until they freeze.

Atlas.name: Annihilate
Atlas.description: Triggers explosions around him that damage and slow enemies.

Atlas.name: Perfect Match
Atlas.description: Ejects from his mecha to move fast, then reunites to stun enemies at the landing spot.

Atlas.name: Fatal Links
Atlas.description: Chains nearby enemies and drags them all toward one point.

Aulus.name: Fighting Spirit
Aulus.description: Stacks power from hitting heroes and grows stronger the longer he fights.

Aulus.name: Aulus, Charge!
Aulus.description: Boosts movement speed and enhances his next attacks.

Aulus.name: The Power of Axe
Aulus.description: Swings his axe in a sweep that slows and damages enemies in front.

Aulus.name: Cleaving Axe
Aulus.description: Swings repeatedly at nearby enemies, then a wide finishing slash, taking less damage while swinging.

Aurora.name: Pride of Ice
Aurora.description: Every few skill casts her next skill freezes the target.

Aurora.name: Hailstone Blast
Aurora.description: Drops an icy meteorite on a spot, damaging and slowing enemies there.

Aurora.name: Frosty Breeze
Aurora.description: Blows a cone of frost that damages enemies and can freeze them.

Aurora.name: Frigid Glacier
Aurora.description: Lays a frost path that slows enemies, then grows into glaciers that shatter for damage.

Badang.name: Chivalry Fist
Badang.description: Every few basic attacks his punch sends a shockwave that hits enemies behind the target.

Badang.name: Fist Wind
Badang.description: Punches a gust forward that damages, slows and knocks back, exploding when it hits an obstacle.

Badang.name: Fist Break
Badang.description: Dashes to a spot and raises a wall of fists that blocks enemy movement.

Badang.name: Fist Crack
Badang.description: Channels a rapid barrage of punches in a direction.

Bane.name: Shark Bite
Bane.description: After a skill cast his next basic attack deals bonus damage.

Bane.name: Crab Claw Cannon
Bane.description: Fires a cannonball that bounces to another enemy after hitting the first.

Bane.name: Ale
Bane.description: Drinks to recover HP and gain speed, then can spit venom in a cone.

Bane.name: Deadly Catch
Bane.description: Sends a school of sharks in a direction, knocking enemies up.

Barats.name: Big Guy
Barats.description: His skills stack up to grow bigger, gaining defense and size.

Barats.name: So-Called Teamwork
Barats.description: Detona spits oil that damages and slows enemies in an area.

Barats.name: Missile Expert
Barats.description: Fires missiles that pull enemies toward him and knock them up.

Barats.name: Detona's Welcome
Barats.description: Detona swallows an enemy hero and spits them out in a chosen direction.

Baxia.name: Baxia Mark
Baxia.description: His attacks reduce the healing enemies receive.

Baxia.name: Baxia-Shield Unity
Baxia.description: Rolls forward at high speed and stuns the first enemy hit.

Baxia.name: Shield of Spirit
Baxia.description: Hurls his shield to damage and slow enemies in a line.

Baxia.name: Tortoise's Puissance
Baxia.description: Leaves a burning trail while moving faster and taking less damage.

Beatrix.name: Mechanical Genius
Beatrix.description: Carries two guns and swaps between them, each with a different attack style.

Beatrix.name: Masterful Gunner
Beatrix.description: Reloads and fires an empowered attack whose effect depends on the equipped gun.

Beatrix.name: Tactical Reposition
Beatrix.description: Rolls in a direction and readies a full magazine.

Beatrix.name: Renner's Apathy / Bennett's Rage / Wesker's Elation / Nibiru's Passion
Beatrix.description: A special shot whose form depends on the equipped gun: a snipe, an explosive round, a spread or a rapid burst.

Belerick.name: Deadly Thorns
Belerick.description: Taking damage lets him retaliate with thorn hits on nearby enemies.

Belerick.name: Ancient Seed
Belerick.description: Sends out roots that damage and slow enemies in a line.

Belerick.name: Nature's Strike
Belerick.description: Regains HP and taunts nearby enemies.

Belerick.name: Wrath of Dryad
Belerick.description: Whips out vines that drag enemies toward him.

Benedetta.name: Elapsed Daytime
Benedetta.description: Holding a basic attack charges sword energy; releasing it dashes and slashes.

Benedetta.name: Phantom Slash
Benedetta.description: Dashes forward and follows with a slash that hits enemies in a line.

Benedetta.name: An Eye for An Eye
Benedetta.description: Raises her blade to block damage, then thrusts and stuns if she was hit.

Benedetta.name: Alecto: Final Blow
Benedetta.description: Dashes through an area, slowing enemies, then returns to slash them again.

Brody.name: Abyss Corrosion
Brody.description: Basic attacks move him slightly and stack marks on the target.

Brody.name: Abyss Impact
Brody.description: Fires a shockwave that damages and slows enemies in a line.

Brody.name: Corrosive Strike
Brody.description: Dashes to a target, stunning them and gaining movement speed.

Brody.name: Torn-Apart Memory
Brody.description: Locks onto marked enemies and unleashes stacked-based damage on each.

Bruno.name: Mecha Legs
Bruno.description: Every critical hit raises his crit damage.

Bruno.name: Volley Shot
Bruno.description: Kicks a ball that damages and slows the first enemy hit, then can be re-kicked.

Bruno.name: Slide
Bruno.description: Slides forward, briefly stunning enemies on the way, and readies a ball at the end.

Bruno.name: Worldie
Bruno.description: Kicks an energy ball at a hero that knocks them back and bounces on to others.

Carmilla.name: Vampire Pact
Carmilla.description: Attacking heroes steals defense from them and grants it to her.

Carmilla.name: Crimson Flower
Carmilla.description: Circles blood blossoms around her that damage nearby enemies and heal her.

Carmilla.name: Bloodbath
Carmilla.description: Dashes to a target, dealing damage and slowing them.

Carmilla.name: Curse of Blood
Carmilla.description: Throws a curse that links nearby enemies so damage spreads between them.

Cecilion.name: Overflowing
Cecilion.description: Hitting enemies with skills permanently increases his max mana.

Cecilion.name: Bat Impact
Cecilion.description: Sends a bat that damages enemies in a line and returns.

Cecilion.name: Sanguine Claws
Cecilion.description: Summons claws that pull enemies to a point and stun them.

Cecilion.name: Bats Feast
Cecilion.description: Moves while continuously firing bats that damage and slow enemies.

Chang'e.name: Trouble Maker
Chang'e.description: Gains a shield when using skills near allies.

Chang'e.name: Starmoon Shockwave
Chang'e.description: Sends an energy sphere that damages and slows enemies; extra spheres follow while her Crescent Moon is up.

Chang'e.name: Crescent Moon
Chang'e.description: Summons a barrier that blocks projectiles and boosts her movement.

Chang'e.name: Meteor Shower
Chang'e.description: Rapid-fires a stream of meteors in a direction while she moves.

Chip.name: Snack Time!
Chip.description: Eats chips while out of combat to regain HP faster.

Chip.name: Crash Course
Chip.description: Jumps and slams the ground, marking enemies; hitting a marked enemy again stuns them.

Chip.name: Overtime
Chip.description: Builds up movement speed, then charges his next attack to knock the target back.

Chip.name: Shortcut
Chip.description: Opens a portal that allies and enemies can use to travel across the map.

Cici.name: Performer's Delight
Cici.description: Dealing damage stacks movement speed and spell vamp.

Cici.name: Yo-Yo Blitz
Cici.description: Swings her yo-yo at an enemy, hitting them repeatedly while she stays close.

Cici.name: Buoyant Bounce
Cici.description: Leaps to a spot and can bounce again toward a target, damaging where she lands.

Cici.name: Curtain Call
Cici.description: Tethers an enemy hero so they take extra damage and are slowed while linked.

Claude.name: Battle Side-by-Side
Claude.description: Dexter, his monkey, attacks alongside him and stacks attack speed.

Claude.name: Art of Thievery
Claude.description: Fires a wave that steals movement and attack speed from enemies hit.

Claude.name: Battle Mirror Image
Claude.description: Places a mirror image he can swap places with.

Claude.name: Blazing Duet
Claude.description: Sprays bullets at all nearby enemies while moving and gains a shield.

Clint.name: Double Shot
Clint.description: After a skill his next basic attack fires a piercing shot.

Clint.name: Quick Draw
Clint.description: Fires a spread of bullets in a cone that damages every enemy hit.

Clint.name: Trapping Recoil
Clint.description: Fires a net that traps the enemy hit while he hops backward.

Clint.name: Grenade Bombardment
Clint.description: Lobs grenades that explode on enemies, with several charges stored.

Cyclops.name: Stardust Shock
Cyclops.description: Fires two waves of star energy in a direction.

Cyclops.name: Planets Attack
Cyclops.description: Summons orbs that circle him and shoot at nearby enemies.

Cyclops.name: Star Power Lockdown
Cyclops.description: Launches a homing orb that chases a target and roots them on impact.

Diggie.name: Young Again
Diggie.description: On death he becomes an egg that can still move, cannot be targeted and revives later.

Diggie.name: Auto Alarm Bomb
Diggie.description: Drops a bomb that chases enemies and explodes to slow them.

Diggie.name: Reverse Time
Diggie.description: Marks a target so they are pulled back to where they were after a delay.

Diggie.name: Time Journey
Diggie.description: Frees nearby allies from crowd control and shields them.

Dyrroth.name: Wrath of the Abyss
Dyrroth.description: Every few basic attacks he deals bonus damage and regains HP.

Dyrroth.name: Burst Strike
Dyrroth.description: Two rapid slashes, the second one slowing enemies hit.

Dyrroth.name: Spectre Step
Dyrroth.description: Dashes forward and can dash again to strike a target.

Dyrroth.name: Abysm Strike
Dyrroth.description: A heavy blow that deals more damage the less HP the target has.

Edith.name: Overload
Edith.description: Casting skills charges her attacks to chain lightning between enemies.

Edith.name: Earth Shatter
Edith.description: Phylax slams the ground to knock enemies into the air.

Edith.name: Onward
Edith.description: Phylax charges forward and tosses the first hero hit over its shoulder.

Edith.name: Primal Wrath
Edith.description: Ejects from Phylax to fight as a ranged attacker with charged shots.

Esmeralda.name: Starmoon Casket
Esmeralda.description: Absorbs enemy shields and turns them into her own shield.

Esmeralda.name: Frostmoon Shield
Esmeralda.description: Gains a shield and movement speed while draining nearby enemies' shields.

Esmeralda.name: Stardust Dance
Esmeralda.description: Sweeps in an arc to damage enemies around her.

Esmeralda.name: Falling Starmoon
Esmeralda.description: Charges and throws a wave that damages and slows enemies in its path.

Faramis.name: Vicious Retrieval
Faramis.description: Gathers soul fragments from fallen units to shorten his death timer.

Faramis.name: Shadow Stampede
Faramis.description: Turns into a shadow, pulling enemies he passes through toward his stop point.

Faramis.name: Ghost Bursters
Faramis.description: Fires a bolt that bounces between enemies.

Faramis.name: Nether Realm
Faramis.description: Turns the area into a realm that shields allies and briefly resurrects them if the shield breaks.

Floryn.name: Dew
Floryn.description: Grants allies a flower item that heals them whenever she heals.

Floryn.name: Sow
Floryn.description: Throws a seed that damages an enemy and heals nearby allies.

Floryn.name: Sprout
Floryn.description: Fires a bolt that bounces to nearby enemies and slows them.

Floryn.name: Bloom
Floryn.description: Heals every ally on the map and shields those with low HP.

Fredrinn.name: Crystalline Armor
Fredrinn.description: Stores a portion of damage taken as energy to spend on his ultimate.

Fredrinn.name: Piercing Strike
Fredrinn.description: Thrusts his blade forward to damage enemies in a line.

Fredrinn.name: Brave Assault
Fredrinn.description: Dashes forward and can follow with a wide sweep that knocks up.

Fredrinn.name: Energy Eruption
Fredrinn.description: Releases stored energy to damage and taunt nearby enemies, gaining defense for each one hit.

Freya.name: Power of Einherjar
Freya.description: Landing skills builds stacks that empower her attacks.

Freya.name: Leap of Faith
Freya.description: Leaps to a spot, damaging and slowing enemies where she lands.

Freya.name: Valkyrie Slash
Freya.description: Charges and slashes to damage and slow enemies, spending Sacred Orbs instead of a cooldown.

Freya.name: Valkyrie Descent
Freya.description: Enters a stronger form with a shield and empowered strikes.

Gatotkaca.name: Steel Bones
Gatotkaca.description: Converts lost HP into extra physical defense.

Gatotkaca.name: Blast Iron Fist
Gatotkaca.description: Punches the ground to damage and slow enemies in a line.

Gatotkaca.name: Unbreakable
Gatotkaca.description: Taunts nearby enemies and gains a shield.

Gatotkaca.name: Avatar of the Guardian
Gatotkaca.description: Leaps to a spot and slams down, knocking enemies into the air.

Gloo.name: Stick, Stick
Gloo.description: Skills leave goo that sticks to enemies and slows them.

Gloo.name: Slam, Slam
Gloo.description: Slams the ground twice to damage and slow enemies nearby.

Gloo.name: Spread, Spread
Gloo.description: Splits into goos that damage and immobilize enemies in a cone, then pulls itself back together.

Gloo.name: Grab, Grab
Gloo.description: Attaches to a fully stuck enemy hero, healing itself and passing most damage it takes onto them.

Gord.name: Mystic Favor
Gord.description: Every few skill hits on a target deal bonus true damage.

Gord.name: Mystic Projectile
Gord.description: Fires an orb that damages and stuns enemies in an area.

Gord.name: Mystic Injunction
Gord.description: Lays a zone that repeatedly damages enemies inside.

Gord.name: Mystic Gush
Gord.description: Channels a wide beam that continuously damages enemies in its path.

Granger.name: Capriccio
Granger.description: His gun and cannon run on demonic energy that refills over time and grows with each kill.

Granger.name: Rhapsody
Granger.description: Fires all remaining bullets in a cone.

Granger.name: Rondo
Granger.description: Dashes forward and reloads a bullet.

Granger.name: Death Sonata
Granger.description: Turns his violin into a cannon and fires powerful long-range rounds.

Grock.name: Bastion of Stone
Grock.description: Periodically gains a shield and an empowered attack that bites a share of max HP, recharging faster near walls.

Grock.name: Mighty Swing
Grock.description: A heavy strike that slams enemies into terrain behind them for extra damage and a knock-up.

Grock.name: Earthen Rampart
Grock.description: Raises a stone wall that damages and knocks back enemies where it appears.

Grock.name: Tectonic Charge
Grock.description: Charges forward; hitting terrain sets off an explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne.

Guinevere.name: Super Magic
Guinevere.description: Casting skills empowers her next basic attack with bonus damage.

Guinevere.name: Energy Wave
Guinevere.description: Fires an energy ball that damages and slows the first enemy hit.

Guinevere.name: Spatial Migration
Guinevere.description: Leaps to a spot, knocking enemies there airborne, and can blink back afterward.

Guinevere.name: Violet Requiem
Guinevere.description: Unleashes a barrage on airborne enemies, keeping them in the air.

Hanabi.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
Hanabi.description: Her attacks launch petal blades that bounce between nearby enemies.

Hanabi.name: Ninjutsu: Equinox
Hanabi.description: Gains a shield that grants control immunity, speed and lifesteal while it holds.

Hanabi.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
Hanabi.description: Throws a scroll that damages and slows enemies in a line.

Hanabi.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
Hanabi.description: Plants a flower that blooms to root enemies caught inside.

Hanzo.name: Ame no Habakiri

Hanzo.name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
Hanzo.description: Devours a target for damage and blood; can also eat jungle monsters.

Hanzo.name: Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
Hanzo.description: Dashes and leaves a mist behind that damages and slows enemies inside it.

Hanzo.name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
Hanzo.description: Leaves his body as a demon that fights independently while the body hides.

Harith.name: Key Insight

Harith.name: Synchro Fission
Harith.description: Sends out a phantom that damages enemies and returns to him.

Harith.name: Chrono Dash
Harith.description: Dashes and empowers his next attack with a shield-boosting strike.

Harith.name: Zaman Force
Harith.description: Creates a rift that slows enemies and resets his dash when he passes through it.

Harley.name: Magic Master

Harley.name: Poker Trick
Harley.description: Throws a spread of cards that damage enemies in front.

Harley.name: Space Escape

Harley.name: Deadly Magic
Harley.description: Places a burning ring on a target that explodes for damage based on hits taken.

Helcurt.name: Shadow of Styx
Helcurt.description: Stays hidden until spotted, regenerating and gaining a burst of speed when he breaks cover.

Helcurt.name: Hidden Terror
Helcurt.description: Blinks to a spot; cast from the shadows it also terrifies nearby enemies.

Helcurt.name: Deadly Stinger
Helcurt.description: Fires a stack of stingers at a target.

Helcurt.name: Dark Night Falls
Helcurt.description: Darkens the map for enemies and boosts his speed.

Hilda.name: Blessing of Wilderness
Hilda.description: Regains HP and moves faster while standing in bushes.

Hilda.name: Combat Ritual
Hilda.description: Charges forward with a shield and boosted speed.

Hilda.name: Art of Hunting
Hilda.description: Slashes twice in a cone to damage and slow enemies.

Hilda.name: Power of Wildness
Hilda.description: Leaps onto a target for a heavy strike that grows with stacked kills.

Hirara.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune

Hirara.name: Meisen-e
Hirara.description: Rides the waves with up to two joystick dashes that damage enemies hit.

Hirara.name: Kaerazu
Hirara.description: Sweeps a crimson maple in a cone, then strikes the target spot again for double damage.

Hirara.name: Infernal Torrent

Hylos.name: Thickened Blood

Hylos.name: Law and Order
Hylos.description: Stuns a target and deals damage.

Hylos.name: Ring of Punishment
Hylos.description: Emits a ring that repeatedly damages and slows nearby enemies.

Hylos.name: Glorious Pathway

Irithel.name: Jungle Heart
Irithel.description: Can fire basic attacks while moving.

Irithel.name: Strafe
Irithel.description: Fires a volley of arrows that lowers enemy defense.

Irithel.name: Force of the Queen

Irithel.name: Heavy Crossbow
Irithel.description: Empowers her attacks to fire piercing bolts.

Ixia.name: Siphon Starlium

Ixia.name: Dual Beam
Ixia.description: Fires twin beams that damage enemies in a line.

Ixia.name: Star Helix
Ixia.description: Dashes and fires a wave that slows enemies.

Ixia.name: Full Barrage
Ixia.description: Unleashes a long barrage of shots at enemies in a wide area.

Jawhead.name: Mecha Suppression
Jawhead.description: His attacks stack marks that make enemies take more damage.

Jawhead.name: Smart Missiles
Jawhead.description: Fires a volley of homing missiles at nearby enemies.

Jawhead.name: Ejector

Jawhead.name: Unstoppable Force
Jawhead.description: Charges at a target, knocking them back and stunning them.

Johnson.name: Electro-airbag
Johnson.description: Gains a shield when his HP drops low.

Johnson.name: Impact Wrench
Johnson.description: Throws his wrench, damaging enemies in its path and stunning those around where it lands.

Johnson.name: Electromagnetic Waves
Johnson.description: Raises his shield to continuously damage and slow enemies in a cone, ramping up on repeat hits.

Johnson.name: Full Throttle

Joy.name: Humph, Joy's Angry!

Joy.name: Look, Leonin Crystal!

Joy.name: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!

Joy.name: Ha, Electrifying Beats!

Julian.name: Smith's Legacy
Julian.description: Casting two different skills empowers the third into a stronger version.

Julian.name: Scythe

Kadita.name: Thalassophobia
Kadita.description: Regains lost HP shortly after taking damage.

Kalea.name: Tidal Strike

Karrie.name: Lightwheel Mark

Khaleed.name: Sand Walk

Leomord.name: The Oath Keeper

Minotaur.name: Motivation Roar

Minotaur.name: Minoan Fury
Minotaur.description: Smashes the ground repeatedly, knocking enemies into the air.

Minsitthar.name: Mark of the King

Minsitthar.name: Shield Assault

Natalia.name: Claw Dash

Natalia.name: The Hunt

Natan.name: Interference!

Natan.name: Entropy?

Nolan.name: Dimensional Rift

Paquito.name: Knockout Strike

Pharsa.name: Spiritual Unity

Pharsa.name: Curse of Crow
Pharsa.description: Fires a curse that damages and stuns the enemy hit.

Pharsa.name: Energy Impact

Pharsa.name: Feathered Air Strike
Pharsa.description: Flies up and bombards an area with several magic strikes.

Phoveus.name: Demonic Force

Phoveus.name: Infernal Pursuit

Popol and Kupa.name: We Are Angry!

Rafaela.name: Divine Resurrection

Rafaela.name: Light of Retribution

Rafaela.name: Holy Healing

Rafaela.name: Holy Baptism
Rafaela.description: Fires a beam that damages and stuns enemies in a line.

Roger.name: Full Moon Curse

Silvanna.name: Knightess' Resolve

Silvanna.name: Cometic Lance

Silvanna.name: Spiral Strangling

Silvanna.name: Imperial Justice
Silvanna.description: Leaps to a spot and traps enemies inside a circle.

Sora.name: Mystic Surge

Sora.name: Sundering Strike

Sora.name: Windstride

Sora.name: Shifting Skies

Sun.name: Simian God

Sun.name: Endless Variety

Sun.name: Clone Techniques

Suyou.name: Blade Surge
Suyou.description: Throws his weapon and blinks to it for a slash.

Terizla.name: Body of Smith

Terizla.name: Revenge Strike

Terizla.name: Execution Strike

Terizla.name: Penalty Zone

Thamuz.name: Grand Lord Lava

Thamuz.name: Cauterant Inferno

Uranus.name: Radiance

Uranus.name: Transcendent Ward

Uranus.name: Consecration

Vale.name: Windtalk

Valentina.name: Primal Force

Valir.name: Ashing

Valir.name: Vengeance Flame
Valir.description: Cleanses debuffs and empowers his skills for a while.

Vexana.name: Deathly Grasp

Vexana.name: Cursed Blast
Vexana.description: Marks an area that erupts after a short delay, damaging enemies inside.

Vexana.name: Eternal Guard
Vexana.description: Summons a knight that fights for her and taunts enemies.

Wanwan.name: Tiger Pace
Wanwan.description: Her basic attacks let her hop; hitting an enemy's weak points unlocks her ultimate.

Wanwan.name: Swallow's Path
Wanwan.description: Throws a fire swallow that splits into daggers which fly back to her, hitting enemies both ways.

Wanwan.name: Needles in Flowers
Wanwan.description: Cleanses debuffs and fires needles at nearby enemies.

Wanwan.name: Crossbow of Tang
Wanwan.description: Becomes untargetable and rapid-fires arrows at a target.

X.Borg.name: Firaga Armor
X.Borg.description: Fights inside a suit of armor with its own HP bar and burns nearby enemies.

X.Borg.name: Fire Missiles
X.Borg.description: Sprays flames in a cone that damages and burns enemies.

X.Borg.name: Fire Stake
X.Borg.description: Fires stakes that pull enemies toward him.

X.Borg.name: Last Insanity
X.Borg.description: Charges forward and self-destructs the armor for a big explosion.

Xavier.name: Transcendence
Xavier.description: Landing skills stacks up to enhance his next skill.

Xavier.name: Infinite Extension
Xavier.description: Fires a bolt that extends when it hits an enemy.

Xavier.name: Mystic Field
Xavier.description: Creates a barrier that slows enemies and speeds up allies.

Xavier.name: Dawning Light
Xavier.description: Fires a global beam that damages every enemy in its line.

Yi Sun-shin.name: Heavenly Vow
Yi Sun-shin.description: Switches between a bow and a sword depending on distance.

Yi Sun-shin.name: Traceless
Yi Sun-shin.description: Dashes and fires a piercing arrow.

Yi Sun-shin.name: Blood Floods
Yi Sun-shin.description: Charges an arrow that deals more damage the longer it is held.

Yi Sun-shin.name: Mountain Shocker
Yi Sun-shin.description: Calls a fleet to bombard the map and reveal enemies.

Yin.name: Leave It to Me
Yin.description: Deals more damage and gains spell vamp when no allies are nearby.

Yin.name: Charged Punch
Yin.description: Dashes forward and punches the first enemy hit.

Yin.name: Instant Blast
Yin.description: Fires a shockwave that damages and slows enemies.

Yin.name: My Turn
Yin.description: Drags an enemy into a separate arena for a one-on-one fight.

Yu Zhong.name: Cursing Touch
Yu Zhong.description: His attacks stack a curse that bursts for bonus damage.

Yu Zhong.name: Dragon Tail
Yu Zhong.description: Whips a tail that damages enemies in a cone.

Yu Zhong.name: Soul Grip
Yu Zhong.description: Sends out an energy pull that damages and slows enemies.

Yu Zhong.name: Black Dragon Form
Yu Zhong.description: Transforms into a dragon that flies over terrain and knocks enemies up.

Yve.name: Galactic Power
Yve.description: Her skills gain extra effects while she stands in her void field.

Yve.name: Void Blast
Yve.description: Fires a wave of energy that damages enemies in a line.

Yve.name: Void Crystal
Yve.description: Sends crystals that damage and slow enemies.

Yve.name: Real World Manipulation
Yve.description: Opens a grid field she can tap to detonate damage across the area.

Zetian.name: Celestial Armament
Zetian.description: Knocks back enemies who get too close and shields her.

Zetian.name: Phoenix Strike
Zetian.description: Fires three waves of magic damage, the last one larger and pulling enemies.

Zetian.name: Phoenix Descent
Zetian.description: Summons a spirit that damages and weakens enemies in an area.

Zetian.name: Fury of the Phoenix
Zetian.description: Speeds up allies while damaging and stunning every enemy hero.

Zhask.name: Decimation
Zhask.description: On death he summons a frenzied spawn that fights until its HP runs out.

Zhask.name: Nightmaric Spawn
Zhask.description: Summons a spawn that attacks nearby enemies.

Zhask.name: Mind Eater
Zhask.description: Fires a wave that damages and slows enemies in a line.

Zhask.name: Dominator's Descent
Zhask.description: Merges with his spawn to become a powerful mobile turret.

Zhuxin.name: Crimson Butterflies
Zhuxin.description: Mana spent on her lantern skill returns as butterflies that restore mana.

Zhuxin.name: Fluttering Grace
Zhuxin.description: Releases a fan of magic that damages enemies in front.

Zhuxin.name: Lantern Flare
Zhuxin.description: Guides a floating lantern around to damage and mark enemies it touches.

Zhuxin.name: Crimson Beacon
Zhuxin.description: Summons a lantern field that slows and damages enemies inside.
